To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we developed a computational method that predicts the regulation of the mRNA coding Smad7 by miRNAs and we identified a miRNAs signature that regulate the mRNA coding for the Smad7 protein, in breast cancer patients.

we developed an automatic search method to identify a predictive model based in DNN that fits the set of biological information and apply the Oldens algorithm to identify the importance of each miRNA.
a computational model based on genetic algorithms and deep neural networks is developed to predict the regulation of mRNA-Smad-7 in breast cancer by miRNAs.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the identification of a miRNAs expression pattern that can be used as a predictive biomarker for the expression of mRNA coding for Smads7 in breast cancer.
the development of a computational model to predict the expression of the Smad7 mRNA in patients with breast tumors.
developing a predictive model of the regulation of mRNA-Smad-7 by miRNAs, based on the data of patients with breast cancer from the Cancer Genome Project.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed model is able to predict mRNA-Smad7 regulation in breast cancer with high accuracy and precision.
a miRNAs signature could be used to predict the mRNA-Smad7 regulation in breast cancer.
miRNAs regulate mRNA expression in patients with breast tumor.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the miRNAs profile can be used as biomarker or target in targeted therapies.
the model based on GA and deep learning could be used for prediction of mRNA expression in patients with breast tumors.
we have developed a computational model that predicts the regulation given by miRNAs on the expression of the mRNAs of the target genes in breast cancer.
The main takeaway from our work is that
miRNAs are critical regulators of the Smad7 mRNA expression in patients with breast tumors and could be considered as biomarkers or therapeutic targets.
we have developed a computational method to identify miRNAs that regulate the expression of mRNA-Smad-7.

the use of deep neural networks in combination with a genetic algorithm to find the best architecture of the neural network is an efficient method to predict the expression of mRNA-Smad 7 in breast cancer.
